title: The roadmap build goes red when a todo step has an open PR
why: Nine steps said todo while their PRs were open (P1, F19/F23); triage fixed them by hand on Nov 1 19:32 CST. Source: owner-feedback audit, claude-settings draft PR #1008 (docs/plans/owner-feedback-audit.md, section 6), Nov 1 20:06 CST.
note: Red first: a fixture step in todo with an open PR whose branch is its slug makes build.py red, naming the step and PR. Ready. Port: yes, shared.
